modules.title: 输入一个关键词后，结果从哪里来
搜索怎样帮助找到候选内容

items.title: 查询来自用户表达
items.text: 用户输入名称、题目或关键词，系统在指定内容字段中寻找可能相关的项目；匹配范围要与界面提示一致，不能暗中只搜标题。

items.title: 结果也需要反馈
items.text: 搜索应显示正在查找、结果数量或空结果，并让用户能修改关键词或清除查询。拼写不同和排序策略可以逐步完善，但不能替代基本可发现性。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 搜索不是筛选。搜索由用户输入的词寻找候选；筛选用类别、状态、价格等已有条件缩小集合。二者可同时使用，但不应把“只看已完成”伪装成关键词搜索。

lessonPractice.title: 用户想找名称或描述里提到“预算”的项目，但不知道项目状态。应该先做什么？

options.label: 搜索“预算”，从名称和描述中找相关项目
options.feedback: 对。目标是从用户输入的词找到候选，不是先指定一个固定分类条件。

options.label: 先筛选“未完成”，再只在剩余项目的标题里搜索“预算”
options.feedback: 状态不能代表“预算”这个词出现在哪里，会遗漏仍在进行中的相关项目。

options.label: 按最近更新时间排序，再从前几页人工查找“预算”
options.feedback: 排序只能改变查看顺序，不能定位关键词；相关项目也可能很久没有更新，人工翻页容易漏掉。

en.title: A person wants projects whose name or description mentions “budget” but does not know their status. What should they use first?

options.label: Search for “budget” across project names and descriptions, then filter further if needed
options.feedback: Correct. The goal is to find candidates from a person's words, not to choose a fixed category condition first.

options.label: Use only a Completed filter because all searches should be by status
options.feedback: Status cannot represent where “budget” appears and would miss relevant in-progress projects.

options.label: Draw a status chart so the person can guess which projects are relevant
options.feedback: Charts compare data; they do not locate specific content by keyword.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为项目列表加搜索：匹配项目名称和描述，输入“预算”能找到相关项目；无结果时显示清楚提示并允许清空关键词。不要把状态筛选混进搜索逻辑。改完后分别测试有结果、无结果和清空输入。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add search to the project list: match project names and descriptions so “budget” finds relevant projects; show a clear empty result and let people clear the query. Do not mix status filtering into search logic. Test results, no results, and clearing the input afterward.

learning.assumes: You have entered a keyword in a site, file list, or help center.
learning.outcome: You can state which fields search should match, how an empty result should appear, and how it differs from a fixed-condition filter.

modules.title: Where results come from after one keyword is entered

items.title: The query comes from the person
items.text: Someone enters a name, topic, or keyword, and the system looks for potentially relevant items in specified fields. The matching scope should match the interface hint, not secretly search title only.

items.title: Results need feedback too
items.text: Search should show that it is working, a result count or empty state, and a way to change or clear the query. Spelling tolerance and ranking can improve later, but cannot replace basic findability.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Search is not filtering. Search uses words someone enters to find candidates; filters use existing conditions such as category, status, or price to shrink a collection. They can work together, but “show completed only” should not be presented as keyword search.

distinctions.label: Filter
distinctions.text: {c:search} uses a query to find possible matches. A {c:filter} applies explicit conditions such as status, date, or category to narrow an existing result set.
